workspace.description: Google Workspace tools: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Chat

authoringHints: Use for email, calendar, drive files, documents, spreadsheets, and internal Google Workspace workflows.

github.description: GitHub repos, issues, pull requests, commits, and code-hosting workflows

authoringHints: Use for repository data, PR review flows, issues, commits, and source-control automation.

apify.description: Apify Store Actors for public-web scraping, extraction, and site-specific automation

authoringHints: Use when the user wants data from public websites, marketplaces, search results, listings, reviews, maps, social profiles, product pages, docs sites, or other web pages.
Assume Apify likely already has a purpose-built Actor for many scraping tasks; prefer selecting a concrete Actor at authoring time instead of writing generic browser logic.

composio.description: Telegram, Slack, and 250+ SaaS integrations via a proxy tool

authoringHints: Use when the workflow needs an app integration outside the built-in connections, especially messaging, CRM, or long-tail SaaS tools.
